description: This file defines a web page code-behind class 'AdminQueue' for managing course queues within an online examination system. It handles session validation, database interactions to check and modify course queue data, and navigational button actions.

classes.name: AdminQueue
classes.description: Code-behind class for the AdminQueue ASP.NET page, handling session checks, database operations related to course queues, and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Initializes the page, retrieves session variables, checks course queue status in the database, and possibly deletes queue entries if empty.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the admin panel page when the home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the AdminQueue page when the profile button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the admin leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the login page.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection changes in the GridView, storing selected row data in session variables, and transfers control to ShowAns.aspx.
